title: Nautical Boat Club - Mount Pleasant
specs: Access to four rivers flowing into Charleston Harbor and the Intracoastal Waterway
Diverse fleet with new boats added every 1-3 years
Free use of water toys including wake boards, ski vests, tubes, and more
On-board orientation required for any boat in fleet
Membership options allow choice of fleet, group, and days to determine pricing

options.name: Gold Fleet Membership
options.detail: Membership with access to Gold fleet boats including sportboats and center/dual console boats

includes: Boat, gear, fuel options, staff support, and water toys included
Boating safety course, on-board orientation, lifejackets, US Coast Guard vessel safety checks, safety gear, and water maps included
Boats come fully fueled and loaded with requested equipment
blurb: Members enjoy boating access to the Wando, Cooper, Ashley, and Stono rivers, Shem Creek, and the Intracoastal Waterway. The club provides a diverse fleet of boats including Platinum and Gold fleets with sportboats, tri-toons, and center consoles. Membership includes boat, gear, fuel options, staff support, and water toys with no slip fees or maintenance hassles.
extraNote: Fuel paid per use · No slip fees, no maintenance or cleaning, no surprise repairs, no winterization or dry storage, no insurance paperwork · Office on the 3rd floor above the Wando River Grill; ground floor door may be locked, press doorbell for access or call 843-855-2526
